name: @avatark/bootstrap
description: Platform Adoption Kit: a single bootstrapProduct() call that composes the registry lookup, Redirect Manager, and Product Switcher into one product's own initialization; a static environment validator (Supabase URL/key, Site/Callback/Preview URL, missing vars, capability mismatches); a conformance checker covering the Product Conformance Checklist; and reference adapters for AvatarK/PrometheusK/GameK/ArenaK/StreamK/StudioK. See docs/PRODUCT_BOOTSTRAP.md.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
